calibration_constants.nucleophile_elbow: candidate Ser must sit in G-x-S-x-G (candidate[S-2]=='G' and candidate[S+2]=='G'); all 4 ACT_SITE-grounded positives match (GWSMG, GYSMG, GHSQG, GYSMG)

register_spacings.margin: reference min/max expanded ~10% and rounded to integers

calibration_constants.source: computed from the reference panel BEFORE any candidate execution; recorded here, frozen by protocol lock

triad_cb_distance_bounds_A.derivation: panel C-beta ranges S-D 8.96-9.41, S-H 6.66-6.94, D-H 4.55-4.79 (see results/panel_triad_geometry_calibration.json), expanded 25% both sides for predicted-structure noise

gates.G1_grounding: >=8 positive PET-hydrolase/cutinase structures + >=3 negative controls, all live-verified at RCSB (title + download sha256); ACT_SITE triads from live UniProt for >=4 positives. MET PRE-LOCK (8 pos, 3 neg, 4 ACT_SITE).
gates.G2_structures: ESMFold structures acquired for >=18/20 candidates (>=90%); every structure's per-residue pLDDT recorded; failures documented as exceptions.
gates.G3_foldseek: >=15/20 candidates pass leg C. Calibration leg: each positive-panel structure queried against the panel DB has a positive-panel non-self best hit.
gates.G4_model: Calibration holds: all 4 ACT_SITE-grounded positives pass legs A and B on their UniProt sequences/PDB structures; tannase (3WA6) and feruloyl esterase (1USW) each fail >=1 leg of A. THEN >=12/20 candidates pass A AND B AND C.
gates.G5_provenance: Every artifact (inputs, ESMFold PDBs, foldseek outputs, scoring tables) sha256-ledgered; pinned versions recorded (foldseek 941cd33, Biopython 1.88, ESMFold API endpoint + access date); all exceptions, negative results, and compute ceilings preserved in results JSONs; no post-lock gate edits.

inputs.reference_alignment: IsPETase mature (A0A0K8P6T7 residues 27-290), same aligner family as R2 (Biopython pairwise global, BLOSUM62 -11/-1)
inputs.shortlist: SP-003-R2 results/shortlist_20.csv (20 candidates, locked outcome of R2)

model_definition.leg_A_sequence_register: candidate-local triad positions from global alignment vs IsPETase mature; PASS if order S<D<H, S->D in [40,61], D->H in [10,36], G-x-S-x-G at Ser
model_definition.leg_B_3d_geometry: on ESMFold structure: C-beta distances within calibration bounds (all three) AND mean pLDDT over the three triad residues >= 50
model_definition.leg_C_structural_family: foldseek best hit by E-value is a positive-panel member with E <= 1e-3 AND alntmscore >= 0.5

notes: PF07519 tannase/feruloyl-esterase family work stays a separate later study; here tannase/FAE serve only as adversarial negative controls.
No simulated data; all structure predictions and searches are real API/local-tool runs with recorded failures.

negatives.1USW: A. niger feruloyl esterase A (O42807 S154 D215 H268)

positives.1CUS: F. vanettenii cutinase 1 (P00590 S136 D191 H204)
positives.5ZOA: T. fusca cutinase cut2 (Q6A0I4 S170 D216 H248)
positives.8ETX: Ancestral PETase 55_547 (no UniProt cross-ref; foldseek only)
positives.8ETY: Ancestral PETase 35_442 (no UniProt cross-ref; foldseek only)

stages.A_grounding: DONE pre-lock: RCSB live search + entry titles; UniProt ACT_SITE features; PubMed grounding; panel PDB downloads with sha256
stages.B_structures: ESMFold API (https://api.esmatlas.com/foldSequence/v1/pdb/) per candidate; pLDDT per residue recorded; failures retried <=3 then recorded as exceptions
stages.C_foldseek: local foldseek 941cd33 easy-search, candidates + panel-vs-panel calibration vs panel DB; output alntmscore + evalue
stages.D_model: register-aware catalytic-motif model, legs A/B/C below, scored per candidate

title: Structure-aware validation of the 20-candidate PET-hydrolase shortlist and a register-aware catalytic-motif model
